run_train_deepsdf: run the DeepSDF autodecoder training script with an experiment directory and optional batch split
run_continue_training: continue training a DeepSDF model from a previous snapshot using the continue flag
create_step_lr_schedule: create a StepLearningRateSchedule that decays the learning rate by a factor every N epochs
create_warmup_lr_schedule: create a WarmupLearningRateSchedule that linearly increases the learning rate over a specified number of epochs
create_constant_lr_schedule: create a ConstantLearningRateSchedule that returns a fixed learning rate value for all epochs
